picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into DOE's Genesis Mission exemplifies the week's dominant theme: a coordinated federal push uniting national labs, industry, and dozens of universities around AI-accelerated science, supercomputing, and quantum research.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restored natural speech to an ALS patient using his own voice — a landmark clinical demonstration of AI's real-world power to restore human capability, not just accelerate research.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: The Commerce Department's $874 million in CHIPS Act letters of intent with seven companies signals a major federal policy commitment to secure the semiconductor supply chain underpinning AI compute.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: UF's six-year retrospective — $511 million in AI research awards, 200+ courses, and a fourth-generation HiPerGator supercomputer — illustrates the scale of institutional investment now driving university AI strategy.
picks.title: AI year in review

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5 million NSF AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation brings together Delaware, UF, Princeton, and Penn to advance clinician-AI collaboration in rehabilitation and health care.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope under the Genesis Mission marks a concrete technical milestone in autonomous, AI-guided scientific instrumentation.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge joining CuspAI's global AI Materials Foundry network extends AI-driven materials design and robotic experimentation across an international academic-industry consortium.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry

picks.editorial_note: RPI's two Genesis Mission awards — including AI-guided rare-earth-free magnet design with Ames National Laboratory — show the initiative funding concrete, technically ambitious materials science.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska's $18 million NSF MRSEC award establishes a major materials research center studying quantum materials for faster, more efficient computing hardware.
picks.title: Husker team earns elite NSF award to drive next generation of materials research

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's GSCo framework, which lets generalist and specialist AI models collaborate on disease diagnosis, points to a promising architectural approach for improving clinical AI accuracy.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Novel AI Framework Enabling Efficient Collaboration between Generalist and Specialist Models for Disease Diagnosis
